The '''Gaulus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]] and [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' place the [[Tellanroaeg system/Legends|Tellanroaeg system]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] within grid square S-17.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> That territory corresponds to a section of the Gaulus sector, according to [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors]. However, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] instead places the Tellanroaeg system in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]], which this article assumes to be erroneous.<ref name="Tellanroaeg" />
